snippet.title: Platera - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Make sure to add Platera to your Steam Wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4324570/Platera/?beta=0

As the land of Platera collapsed, a new world unfolded within the walls. Your expressive movement system puts the power in your hands to explore and hack and slash your way through a gothic voxel world, in this 3D platformer metroidvania.

A playable demo should be available in the near future.

If you wanna be part of testing, feedback and shaping the game, or just interested in news, join our Discord server: https://discord.gg/Ese6Umm

Thanks to Wooden Pixel Music for the background music made for this game! https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCMTxq2QUPRVo_6tf8MEEJ-g
